subprocess_flow.description: Assemble all mandatory upstream governance artifacts into a consolidated stage-gate compliance package. The Enterprise Architect reviews the submitted deliverables against completeness criteria and registers the dossier within the digital governance workflow tool to prepare for asynchronous inspection.
success_criteria: 100% of mandatory gate artifacts submitted and structurally verified
Automated checklist validation passes without missing documentation
Dossier accessible to all Board members in secure repository
subprocess_flow.purpose: Verify that all required compliance documentation, security approvals, and quality scorecards are complete and ready for board review.
subprocess_flow.scope: Pre-gate intake and structural verification of AI governance artifacts across MoJ digital assets.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Formal gate submission request by AI Project Lead upon completion of assessment phases
end_conditions: Issuance of Dossier Completeness Validation Report and dispatch to review panel

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Incomplete or outdated audit documentation submitted to the board
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated document hashing and validation script ensuring all Phase 1-4 deliverables match registry records

governance_requirements: UK Government Service Standard Gate Reviews

change_management.change_request_process: Missing artifacts trigger immediate intake halt and notification to Project Lead via Jira/ServiceNow
change_management.versioning_rules: Dossier stamped with immutable build tag and registered in artifact vault

improvement_inputs: Time taken to achieve dossier completeness

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Execute Asynchronous Pre-Review and Concurrent Sign-Off
subprocess_flow.description: Distribute the compiled gate dossier across specialised board review tracks including legal, cybersecurity, data privacy, and ethical assurance. Board members perform asynchronous pre-review and log concurrent non-blocking approvals within the governance registry, resolving low-level queries prior to the formal board session.
success_criteria: All designated domain reviewers submit formal review logs
Concurrent sign-off completed for non-blocking compliance checks
Critical blocking observations catalogued for live discussion
subprocess_flow.purpose: Decouple domain-specific compliance evaluations from live meetings and prevent queueing bottlenecks during formal board review.
subprocess_flow.scope: Independent asynchronous review by DPO, CISO, CDO, and independent model auditors.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Publication of the Compiled Stage-Gate Dossier to the Board workflow platform
end_conditions: All domain-specific concurrent approvals logged and open questions synthesised

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Domain reviewers fail to submit feedback within allocated window causing pipeline stalls
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated reminder notifications and designated backup reviewer delegations after 24 business hours

change_management.change_request_process: Reviewers submit formal clarification requests through the central governance portal
change_management.versioning_rules: All reviewer comments and concurrent stamps timestamped and cryptographically logged

improvement_inputs: Concurrent sign-off completion percentage prior to live board session

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Convene MoJ AI Governance Board Formal Session
subprocess_flow.description: Convene the full MoJ AI Governance Board to evaluate unresolved cross-functional risks, deliberate on contentious algorithmic fairness and security trade-offs, and vote on stage-gate approval. The session concludes with recorded deliberations and a binding determination on system viability.
dependencies: Execute Asynchronous Pre-Review and Concurrent Sign-Off
success_criteria: Board quorum met with key domain leads present
Majority or unanimous recorded voting consensus on gate progression
All residual risks assigned clear operational owners and mitigation horizons
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide definitive, multidisciplinary executive scrutiny and formal collective decision-making on whether the AI system is fit for justice sector operations.
subprocess_flow.scope: Deliberation and voting by executive stakeholders including CDO, CISO, Lead Legal Counsel, and Senior Enterprise Architect.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Conclusion of asynchronous pre-review and collation of the concurrent sign-off registry
end_conditions: Formal ratification of Board vote and publishing of Stage-Gate Review Minutes

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Deadlock or lack of quorum preventing timely deployment authorization
step_risks_and_controls.control: Pre-defined executive escalation path to MoJ Chief Technology Officer and SIRO for tie-breaking votes

governance_requirements: UK Government Service Standard Gate Reviews

change_management.change_request_process: Conditional approvals require formal remediation plan approval before certificate release
change_management.versioning_rules: Session minutes signed by Board Chair and recorded under permanent audit index

improvement_inputs: Ratio of unanimous vs contested board determinations

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Publish Algorithmic Transparency Record and Filings
subprocess_flow.description: Finalize and publish the public and internal algorithmic transparency filings in accordance with Central Digital and Data Office standards. The DPO and Project Lead review and index the completed Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) record and record all statutory GDPR Article 35 declarations in central government registers.
dependencies: Convene MoJ AI Governance Board Formal Session
success_criteria: ATRS entry uploaded and accepted by the CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Hub
Information Asset Owner records updated in MoJ asset inventory
Statutory DPIA obligations signed off by DPO
subprocess_flow.purpose: Fulfil UK Government transparency mandates and legal accountability requirements for algorithmic decision-making systems.
subprocess_flow.scope: Regulatory and public algorithmic transparency filings across MoJ and central HMG data repositories.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Formal Board Determination Decision approving project progression
end_conditions: Receipt of official ATRS publication confirmation reference

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Inadvertent publication of sensitive operational security details or OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE logic
step_risks_and_controls.control: Dual-sign-off red-team disclosure review prior to external publishing to CDDO registry

governance_requirements: Freedom of Information Act 2000 Section 24/31 exemptions

change_management.change_request_process: Updates to ATRS entries follow the CDDO revision request pipeline and require IAO approval
change_management.versioning_rules: Published ATRS versioned major.minor with persistent URI

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Issue Conformance Certificate and Authority to Operate
subprocess_flow.description: Generate and cryptographically sign the auditable MoJ AI Conformance Certificate and formal Authority to Operate (ATO). The Enterprise Architect locks the entire governance package into the 7-year immutable audit repository and authorizes production deployment access within the secure cloud enclave.
dependencies: Convene MoJ AI Governance Board Formal Session
Publish Algorithmic Transparency Record and Filings
success_criteria: MoJ AI Conformance Certificate cryptographically signed by Process Owners
Production Authority to Operate (ATO) delivered to MLOps engineering lead
Complete 7-year immutable audit bundle securely archived
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide binding, auditable deployment clearance and release production cloud environment controls for live system operation.
subprocess_flow.scope: Formal certification, cryptographic stamping, cloud enclave release gating, and legal audit archiving.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Verification of ATRS publication and formal board determination sign-off
end_conditions: Release of production deployment gates and ingestion of final certificate into the MoJ Centralized Data Catalog

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Deployment to production infrastructure prior to cryptographic certificate issuance
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated cloud IAM pipeline policy preventing production CD/CI deployment without valid cryptographic certificate token

governance_requirements: MoJ Records Management & Retention Policy (7-year rule)

change_management.change_request_process: Certificate revocation or scope modifications require reconvening the AI Governance Board
change_management.versioning_rules: Certificate assigned unique cryptographic UUID linked to model hash and version

improvement_inputs: Total lead time from submission to certificate release
Audit record retrieval speeds during post-deployment checks
